pickupnotifier.setting.client_only.toolt: Force client-side inventory/XP tracking instead of server pickup payloads.
pickupnotifier.setting.include_items.too: Show collected item entities in the pick-up notifications.
pickupnotifier.setting.include_experienc: Show collected experience orbs in the pick-up notifications.
pickupnotifier.setting.include_arrows.to: Show collected shot arrows in the pick-up notifications.
Show experience points collected instead of the number of individual orbs.
pickupnotifier.setting.disable_in_creati: Prevent entries from being added while in creative mode.
pickupnotifier.setting.combine_entries.t: Combine entries of the same type instead of showing each one individually.
pickupnotifier.setting.display_time.tool: Ticks each entry stays on screen. Set to 0 to keep entries until space is needed.
pickupnotifier.setting.move_out.tooltip: Direction outdated entries slide off screen.
pickupnotifier.setting.move_time.tooltip: Ticks it takes for an entry to slide off screen.
pickupnotifier.setting.fade_out.tooltip: Gradually fade outdated entries away instead of vanishing abruptly.
pickupnotifier.setting.draw_sprite.toolt: Show a small item or experience orb icon next to each entry.
pickupnotifier.setting.default_text_colo: Color for entry name text when rarity coloring does not apply.
pickupnotifier.setting.ignore_rarity.too: Ignore item rarity when choosing entry text color.
pickupnotifier.setting.screen_corner.too: Screen corner or edge where the pick-up list is anchored.
pickupnotifier.setting.offset_x.tooltip: Horizontal offset in pixels from the anchored screen edge.
pickupnotifier.setting.offset_y.tooltip: Vertical offset in pixels from the anchored screen edge.
pickupnotifier.setting.max_height.toolti: Maximum percentage of screen height entries are allowed to occupy.
pickupnotifier.setting.display_scale.too: Scale of entries (divided by 6, works with GUI Scale).
pickupnotifier.setting.display_amount.to: Where to display the collected count: Off, Sprite, Text, or Both.
pickupnotifier.setting.inventory_count.t: Append the total amount of that item currently in your inventory.
pickupnotifier.setting.display_single_co: Show the count even when only a single item was picked up.
Background style behind each entry: None, Chat, or Tooltip.
pickupnotifier.setting.display_item_name: Show the item's name next to its icon and count.
